verdict.rationale: The first-party CLI docs list a `chat` command that starts an interactive chat with a model, also documented as "Chat in the terminal | `lms chat`". Related `lms load` docs show models can be loaded from the terminal with options. The evidence is only a one-line command listing, though, with no detail on session behavior. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of `lms chat` options and session features (e.g., model selection, system prompts, history), and independent or hands-on corroboration of terminal chat usage.
